name: Prebill exception review
summary: Before the billing attorney opens a prebill, the billing coordinator has every awkward entry marked: rates that differ from the firm's rate table, possible duplicates, entries outside the client's billing guidelines, unclear narratives and expenses without support, each sent to the person who acts next.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of law-firm billing work, the prebill review in particular, written up as this workflow template.
